description: This file is a PHP script responsible for handling the export of records in the vtiger CRM application. It initializes necessary dependencies, sets up the Smarty templating engine, retrieves selected records, and displays the appropriate export or error template based on user permissions.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty templating engine instance customized for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab or category related to the current module.

methods.name: getSelectedRecords
methods.description: Obtains selected record IDs from the request parameters.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has administrator privileges.

methods.name: isPermitted
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has the necessary permissions for a specific action on the module.

methods.name: vtlib_getModuleTemplate
methods.description: Fetches the template file path for a given module and template name.

methods.name: getTranslatedString
methods.description: Retrieves the translated string for a given key in the current language.
